name: Pure noise
description: Two independent series with no causal link. news_mentions is a Poisson process (lambda=20), market is a geometric random walk with sigma=0.01 log-returns. There is NO signal.

expected_method_behavior.comment: A method that flags >10% of S1 seeds as containing a signal is broken — it generates false positives on pure noise.

use_in_phase_A: FPR baseline; both calibration and hold-out methods
